basis: The chart shows a continuous decline in the Reservoir Storage Level Index from 23.9 in 2005 to 10.1 in 2014. This represents a decrease of 13.8 index points, which is approximately a 58% drop over the 10-year period. Given the magnitude of this decline, it is visually and numerically consistent with a 'substantial change' rather than 'ordinary variation.' The third option (archive) is inappropriate as the data represents a recent review period (2005-2014) requiring active routing. Although the specific numeric threshold for 'substantial' is not defined in the text, the magnitude of the change strongly justifies the follow-up route.
option_label: Route the 2005 to 2014 reservoir storage change to substantial-change follow-up
